changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Follow') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Follow]( [ResourceID] [int] NOT NULL, [ObjectType] [varchar](50) NOT NULL, [ObjectID] [int] NOT NULL, [DateCreated] [datetime] NOT NULL, [FollowTypeID] [int] NULL, [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Follow] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Follow_ObjectType-ObjectID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Follow_ObjectType-ObjectID] ON [dbo].[Follow] ( [ObjectType] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Follow_ResourceID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Follow_ResourceID] ON [dbo].[Follow] ( [ResourceID] ASC ) END
